literature.title: Evidence for a shared genetic susceptibility to migraine and epilepsy.
literature.abstract: Although epilepsy and migraine are known to co-occur within individuals, the contribution of a shared genetic susceptibility to this comorbidity remains unclear. literature.abstract: Gender differences in the incidence and clinical course of acquired and "cryptogenic" epilepsy are reviewed based on a literature search. literature.title: Epileptic diathesis: An EEG-LORETA study.
literature.journal: Clinical neurophysiology : official journal of the International Federation of Clinical Neurophysiology
literature.abstract: Epileptic diathesis is an inherited neurophysiological trait that contributes to the development of all types of epilepsy. The amount of resting-state electroencephalography (EEG) theta activity is proportional to the degree of cortical excitability and epileptic diathesis. Our aim was to explore the amount and topographic distribution of theta activity in epilepsy groups. We hypothesized that the anatomical distribution of increased theta activity is independent of the epilepsy type.

原發性遺傳性青光眼由基因突變（MYOC、CYP1B1 等）驅動房水動力學異常，與 atropine 抗膽鹼機制無已知直接交叉點。零文獻支持，且與 open-angle glaucoma 分析相同的眼壓升高安全性顧慮適用，雙重否定（無機轉+有害副作用）。
眉毛蟲蝕狀紅斑與 atrophoderma vermiculata 同屬毛囊角化症譜系（KRAS 通路相關），均為遺傳性皮膚角化異常，無已知與膽鹼能系統的生物學交叉。零文獻、零試驗，TxGNN 預測極可能源於這兩種疾病在 HPO/OMIM 知識圖譜中的緊密疾病分類鄰接性，屬圖譜雜訊而非真實訊號。
